title: The Mountain of the LORD

questions.question: It shall come to pass in the latter days that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established as the highest of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:2 (ESV): "shall be established as the highest of the mountains,"

questions.question: And they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:4 (ESV): "and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks;"

questions.question: Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn what anymore?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:4 (ESV): "neither shall they learn war anymore."

questions.question: O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:5 (ESV): "O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the LORD."

questions.question: Enter into the rock and hide in the dust from before the terror of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:10 (ESV): "hide in the dust from before the terror of the LORD,"

questions.question: For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:3 (ESV): "and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem."

questions.question: For you have rejected your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full of things from the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:6 (ESV): "because they are full of things from the east and of fortune-tellers like the Philistines,"

questions.question: Their land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:7 (ESV): "Their land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures;"

questions.question: The haughty looks of man shall be brought low, and the lofty pride of men shall be humbled, and the LORD alone will be what in that day?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:11 (ESV): "and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day."

questions.question: Stop regarding man in whose nostrils is breath, for of what account is he?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:22 (ESV): "Stop regarding man in whose nostrils is breath, for of what account is he?" (Context implies "little" or "none", but the question asks for the phrase "of what account is he" -> answer "Little" or the concept. Wait, strict answer is "Little" isn't in text, text is rhetorical. Rephrasing question to fit options better or changing option). Correct answer concept is "he is of no account". Let's change options to meaningful words. "Of what account is he?" Answer: "He is of no account" (implied). Let's try direct quote completion.

questions.question: For the LORD of hosts has a day against all that is proud and lofty, against all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:12 (ESV): "against all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;"

questions.question: Against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up; and against all the oaks of where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:13 (ESV): "and against all the oaks of Bashan;"

questions.question: Against all the ships of Tarshish, and against all the beautiful what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:16 (ESV): "and against all the beautiful craft."

questions.question: And the idols shall utterly pass what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:18 (ESV): "And the idols shall utterly pass away."

questions.question: In that day mankind will cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold... to the moles and to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:20 (ESV): "to the moles and to the bats,"

questions.question: To enter the caverns of the rocks and the clefts of the cliffs, from before the terror of the LORD... when he rises to terrify the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:21 (ESV): "when he rises to terrify the earth."

key_verse_text: He shall judge between the nations, and shall decide disputes for many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore.
